quantiles: interpolated from 131072 equal-width full-grid histogram bins; approximate boundaries
statistics: exact membership and float64 sums over every grid point; no sampling
volume: count / full-domain count (bin mass, not density)

value_range.meaning: central 50% of point values WITHIN each x bin; not mean confidence interval
value_range.method: cached all-point histograms; interpolated quantiles for all bins
value_range.mean_and_x_bins: unchanged from previous CSV; per-bin counts verified exactly
